title: Equivariant deformation theory and deformations of homogeneous varieties
summary: We show that, in characteristic $p$, almost all projective homogeneous varieties under a reductive group and with non-reduced stabilizer do not lift to characteristic $p^2$. To this end, first we develop a general framework for equivariant deformation theory, leading to practical criteria ensuring that the deformations of a scheme come with deformations of a group scheme action.
